reason: I'd actually love a Georgian toast game for our get-togethers abroad, but it only ships within Georgia, so I can't just order it. I'd have to wait for someone to bring it next time they visit, and by then I'd probably forget.
objection: No delivery outside Georgia, and 45 lari for 90 cards still feels steep for something that might get boring after a few rounds once everyone has used the same words.
would_change_my_mind: International shipping to where I live (or a print-and-play/digital version) at a reasonable delivery cost.
